abort_rules: eligible N < 300 in any formation month -> fail-closed, run halts
a post-entry exit price bar is missing for a held ticker -> official run halts with status INCOMPLETE_PRICE_PANEL
the recomputed SHA-256 of either PIT source artifact does not match the value recorded in pit_source_artifacts -> run halts before any market data fetch

cost_assumptions.wml_net_result_note: WML's net-of-cost result must never be presented as deployment-ready, since no short-borrow cost data exists for it

data_source.asof_parameter: set to formation_date on every per-formation-date request
data_source.current_tradability_filter_reason: a 'tradable today' filter would introduce survivorship bias
data_source.existing_market_data_helper_note: src/data/alpaca_market_data.py returns raw (unadjusted) bars by default and is NOT modified; this study's loader is isolated and pins Adjustment.ALL/IEX/asof explicitly itself
data_source.market_cap_filter_reason: no verified point-in-time market-cap panel is available; Alpaca provides no historical market cap, so ranking by today's market cap would be look-ahead; the original JT method also uses no arbitrary Top-N -- S&P 500 membership itself is the large-cap/liquidity proxy
data_source.spy_benchmark_source: same provider/feed/adjustment settings as the universe fetch

eligibility_gates.absolute_dollar_volume_threshold_reason: IEX feed consolidated liquidity is not a reliable measure
eligibility_gates.bar_coverage_window: expected NYSE sessions across the 12-month formation window
eligibility_gates.identity_warning_exclusion_note: any ticker present in get_membership_as_of(...).identity_warnings is excluded from ranking for that formation date
eligibility_gates.momentum_price_requirement: required momentum start/end prices and the entry Open must all be positive and present
eligibility_gates.price_history_requirement: 12 completed months of history in the required M-12..M-1 window
eligibility_gates.volume_requirement: positive volume in at least 60 of the last 63 sessions

excluded_from_this_round: the existing cap=6 / 6% position sizing engine

execution.entry_rule: Open of the first real NYSE session after formation
execution.exit_rule: Open of the next monthly rebalance (K=1 month, non-overlapping portfolios)

final_classification_note: NATIVE_REPRODUCTION_PROXY: signal/ranking methodology close to JT/Fama-French, but uses a community-source S&P 500 PIT reconstruction and Alpaca IEX data instead of a full CRSP NYSE/AMEX/NASDAQ panel.

formation_dates.rule: the last REAL NYSE session of each calendar month, resolved from Alpaca's own market calendar -- no weekday assumption used anywhere

label: NATIVE_REPRODUCTION_PROXY — RESEARCH_ONLY_NOT_DEPLOYMENT
methodology_note: This is NOT a full Jegadeesh-Titman replication. The original study ranked every NYSE/AMEX stock with sufficient return history into deciles and equal-weighted them. This study's S&P 500 PIT universe is a large-cap proxy for that universe, not a reproduction of it.

metric_definitions.sharpe_annualization_note: equity-only; the existing V1 helper (metrics.py) uses 365.25 and must NOT be silently reused for this study
metric_definitions.wml_spy_alpha_note: the V1-style alpha comparison is used only on the Winner-only panel

missing_data_handling.post_entry_exit_data_loss_policy: if exit-date price data is missing for a ticker already held, the trade is never silently dropped -- the official performance run halts with status INCOMPLETE_PRICE_PANEL
missing_data_handling.sensitivity_variant_allowed: separate, explicitly labeled zero-recovery / last-valid-price sensitivity results may be produced separately from the official run

performance_period.description: 83 full monthly holding periods, January 2019 - November 2025

pit_universe.live_or_current_universe_modules_note: src/live/live_universe.py and src/live/control_universe.py must never be imported anywhere in this study's code path

purpose: Freeze every parameter of a native-universe equity cross-sectional 12-1 momentum reproduction proxy BEFORE any market data is fetched or any backtest result is inspected -- same performance-blind pre-registration discipline as data/research/sp_midcap400_control_universe_snapshot_20260815_165011.json.

randomization.bootstrap_seed_usage: recorded explicitly in the result artifact if a bootstrap procedure is actually used

reporting_panels.DEPLOYMENT_BRIDGE_WINNER_LONG_ONLY: Winner long only; a separate, secondary diagnostic panel -- NOT a deployment-readiness test
reporting_panels.NATIVE_PRIMARY_WML: Winner long / Loser short decile spread -- the main literature-comparable panel

result_interpretation_guardrail: Even a favorable result means only 'a momentum candidate was validated on a large-cap PIT proxy' -- it does NOT mean deployment-ready.

observed_strict_vs_permissive_gap.observed_on: the current PIT artifact, monthly queries 2019-2025

sensitivity_runs.ordering_rule: the primary strict run must complete fully BEFORE the permissive sensitivity run starts; permissive results must never be used to select or alter parameters

signal.example: a 31 Dec 2024 formation date uses the return from end-of-Dec-2023 to end-of-Nov-2024; December 2024 itself is fully excluded (prior 2-12 approach, skips the short-term-reversal month)
signal.tie_break: deterministic: alphabetical ticker order on equal momentum

standard_disclaimer: PIT-reconstructed, community-source data (Wikipedia-anchored S&P 500 membership event reconstruction, not a licensed point-in-time index constituent feed) -- see src/research/pit_universe/membership_query.py's own module docstring for the full reconstruction methodology, the STRICT/PERMISSIVE distinction, and known limitations.
